title: EEP Access Restriction Response (402)
description: Schema for the HTTP 402 response body returned when an agent requests a resource that requires a higher tier. The response is machine-readable so agents can programmatically determine what requirements to satisfy. Served as `application/problem+json` per RFC 9457; the EEP-specific members below are problem extension members.

type.description: RFC 9457 problem type URI identifying what went wrong. Dereferencing it SHOULD yield human-readable documentation. Clients match on this rather than on the HTTP status, which is why it is the stable identifier.

title.description: RFC 9457 short, human-readable summary of the problem type. MUST NOT change from occurrence to occurrence — vary `detail`, not `title`.

status.description: RFC 9457 HTTP status code, repeated in the body so the problem document survives being logged or forwarded away from its response.

detail.description: RFC 9457 human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence. Intended for a developer reading a log, not for an end user.

instance.description: RFC 9457 URI reference identifying this specific occurrence.

resource.description: The resource pattern that was requested but not accessible.

current_tier.description: The tier the agent currently has access to.

required_tier.description: The minimum tier required to access the requested resource.

unmet_requirements.description: List of requirements the agent has not yet satisfied. Each entry includes the requirement type, the specific fields needed, and an optional resolution hint for the agent.

type.description: The requirement type that was not met.

resolution_hint.description: A human/agent-readable hint on how to satisfy this requirement.
examples: Present a VC of type AcademicAffiliation
Your trust score is 32; minimum required is 50
Follow this entity to gain access

available_tiers.description: Map of tiers that would grant access to the requested resource. Includes their labels, requirements, and access patterns so agents can choose which tier to satisfy.

gates_config_url.description: URL where the full gate configuration can be retrieved.

retry_after.description: Optional: seconds to wait before retrying (e.g., if a time-based requirement will be met soon).
